audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart claimed 'Skill' for every full-layer row while the content layer said Brand, and the two layers disagreed at Level 6, First item and 2+ items.
audit.why: Brand's level 3 E-Q package and W wave clear beat a level-1-to-5 Azir who has no burst and must last-hit behind soldiers. Past two items Azir's soldier range and Emperor's Divide invert it. Win rate 48.75% over 160 games reflects the late-game flip, not lane.
audit.corrected: Brand L1-L4/5, even at 6 (both ults), Brand on first item, Azir at two-plus items.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text invented 'a wall/knockback synergy' for Brand, who has neither.
audit.why: Brand's kit has no displacement. The real level 3 spike is E (Conflagration, point-and-click) applying Blaze so Q (Sear) is a guaranteed stun; Azir's counter-window is Shifting Sands at 22s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text around E-into-Q and the 22s Shifting Sands cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Shifting Sands shields as well as dashes, and it can only travel to an existing Sand Soldier. wants.foe[0] also invented 'Q auto-resets' and wants.you[1] invented an E 'recast window'.
audit.why: Azir's E shield absorbs the front of your burst, so a Sear stun landed into a fresh shield wastes the whole rotation. It also requires a soldier as a destination — no soldier, no escape. Neither fact appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text and wants entries.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldown numbers.
audit.corrected: Now names Shifting Sands 22s, Conflagration 13s and Pyroclasm 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim (lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Body did not match its title.
audit.corrected: Both replaced with title-matching, kit-grounded text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Brand's W carries a derived 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Pillar of Flame describes only delayed area damage with +25% to ablaze targets. The flag contradicts the description, so it is a tooltip-parsing misfire and was not used anywhere in the rewrite.
audit.corrected: No claim written that Pillar of Flame blocks Shifting Sands.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stun into W is half a health bar at level 3. He respects every cast from here or pays.
edits.after: Full kit: E applies Blaze point-and-click, Q then stuns for free, W lands on the stunned body. He pays or backs off.

edits.before: Pyroclasm online — any clumped trade is now a detonation chain. Lane all-ins favor the arsonist.
edits.after: Both ults land — Pyroclasm punishes clumps, Emperor's Divide walls your kill away. Even trade of buttons.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the burn makes every rotation percent-health math. Force extended exchanges.
edits.after: Liandry's lands before his second item — your last clean window to force extended burn exchanges.

edits.before: Late Brand is a teamfight detonator: spread Blaze, R the clump, and watch three health bars argue with physics.
edits.after: Two items in, his soldier range and Emperor's Divide out-space you — you detonate clumps only if his wall misses.

edits.before: Same pattern continues — Azir still lacks the tools to punish your poke at this stage.
edits.after: Level 3 completes E-Q: point-and-click ablaze, then a guaranteed Sear stun — your kill pattern.

edits.before: Azir's ultimate wall gives him a genuine tool to separate you from allies or escapes, flipping this phase to him.
edits.after: Both ults arrive: Pyroclasm chains through clumps while Emperor's Divide separates you from allies — the phase reads even.

edits.before: In extended late-game teamfights his wall control and soldier zoning can outweigh your burst if he's ahead, making this an even-to-slightly-his phase.
edits.after: In extended teamfights his soldier zoning out-ranges your 625-range E, and one Emperor's Divide splits your team off you — the phase belongs to him.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E-Q stun package like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1, and it needs a live Sand Soldier to travel to — no soldier, no escape. - Your E is 13s at rank 1: no E, no Blaze, no Sear stun. - Pyroclasm is 100s, so spend it on a commit, never on poke.

edits.before: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame covers the ground he must stand on to farm behind soldiers, and ablaze targets take 25% extra from it.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Conflagration is point-and-click, so it lands through his soldier screen and sets Blaze for the Sear stun however he spaces it.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Shifting Sands shields the front of your burst, so a rotation dumped into a fresh shield leaves you 13 seconds with no Blaze and no stun.

edits.before: Azir wins by landing Shifting Sands, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Azir wins by farming behind soldiers, shielding clear of your Sear window, and out-scaling you badly past two items.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry by killing him before two items — after that his soldiers out-range everything you own and Emperor's Divide undoes your commit.

edits.before: Ahead, scorch the map: rotation-poke Azir off every wave, stun the answers, and R every river clump — fed Brand turns skirmishes into actuarial tables.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the farm: shove with W-E so he must last-hit under tower, punish every step-up with E-Q, and take mid plates before his two-item kite arrives.

edits.before: Once you can chain Q (Sear) into a wall/knockback synergy or just land it raw, you punish Azir's low base mobility before he has 2 items to kite behind soldiers; your combo threatens 2-shot potential on a squishy target that can't yet wall off damage.
edits.after: Level 3 gives you E into Q: Conflagration is point-and-click so Blaze always applies, and Sear then stuns a target that cannot dodge it. Shifting Sands is 22 seconds at rank 1 and needs a live Sand Soldier to travel to, so step up while the shield-dash is spent.

edits.before: Bait his E dash onto a soldier so you can punish the recast window
edits.after: Bait Shifting Sands early — it is 22s at rank 1 and his only escape

edits.before: Farm safely behind soldiers and poke with Q auto-resets
edits.after: Farm safely behind soldiers and poke with Conquering Sands

notes: Chart rows were in cross-layer disagreement before this audit (full said 'Skill' everywhere, content named Brand/Azir, and rows 4-6 argued with their own whys). The chart edits above are one atomic group producing: Brand, Brand, Brand, Brand, Skill, Brand, Azir. Rows 0-3 needed only the full-layer side moved because content win[0..3] already read 'Brand'; row 4 needed only win[4] because phases[4].side already read 'Skill'. Brand's W carries a derived 'terrain' flag that contradicts Riot's description of Pillar of Flame; treated as a parsing misfire and not used.
